transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I got scared by some thoughts I’ve been having. I don’t have any plan to hurt myself, but I’ve caught myself thinking, “It would be simpler if I just didn’t wake up tomorrow.” That’s not like me, and it worried me enough to come talk to someone.
Over the last two weeks, have you felt down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yes. Most days lately I’ve felt pretty down. It’s like there’s a gray film over everything. Even simple things, like making tea or looking out at my garden, feel heavy somehow. I can still do them, but there’s this quiet heaviness in me that I can’t really talk myself out of.
Have you found that things you usually enjoy don’t feel as rewarding or pleasurable lately? Like your favorite activities or time with loved ones?

Yes. I used to really enjoy watercolor painting, but lately even that feels flat. I’ll get my paints and paper out, and then I just sit there looking at it. The pleasure I used to get from the colors and the light just doesn’t come, so I end up putting it all away.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these feelings been going on for at least two weeks, or have they been present for a longer period, like months or more?
It’s been longer than two weeks. I’d say about eight months now. It started around when my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly, and it’s just sort of stayed with me since then.
Have you had any prior episodes of depression like this before, where you felt persistently down and lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having another time quite like this before, at least not that stands out to me. I’ve had sad periods like anyone, but I can’t say there was a clear episode like this.
Have your feelings of sadness and loss of interest been present almost every day and for most of the day without any significant break in symptoms for at least two years now?
No, not two years. It’s been about eight months, since my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly. It’s felt pretty steady since then, but not that long.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if it wasn’t as long or as intense as what you’re experiencing now?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of a clear time before this where it lasted two weeks like that. I’ve been sad at different points, but nothing that I’d say was the same kind of stretch.

In addition to feeling down and losing interest in things, have you experienced any other changes nearly every day for most of the day, such as trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, trouble concentrating, feeling guilty, or feeling like you’re moving really slowly or are restless?

Yes, my sleep has definitely changed. I don’t fall asleep very smoothly, and then I often wake up around three or four in the morning thinking about phone calls, forms, and whether I handled things the right way. By morning I feel like I’ve barely rested.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
I really don’t think so. I’ve had sad times before, of course, but I can’t remember any earlier period where I felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks straight like this.

Since this episode started about eight months ago, have you had any additional periods since then where your mood got significantly worse for a time, even if it didn’t last as long as this main stretch?
I’m not sure I’d call it separate periods. It’s been more of a steady low stretch, with some days worse than others. I haven’t really noticed a distinct new episode on top of it.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
Not that I can remember. I’ve had normal sad periods before, but nothing that went on for two weeks in a row like this.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t think so, no. Before this, I had normal ups and downs, but I can’t recall anything that lasted like that for two weeks straight.
Before this current period, have you ever had at least two separate times in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
No, I don’t think I’ve had two separate times like that before. I can’t really recall even one stretch before this that lasted two weeks straight.
Before this current period, have you ever had at least two separate times in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
No, not that I can think of. I know I’ve answered this already, but I really don’t remember having two separate periods like that before this one.
Before this current period, have you ever had even one other time in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
No, I really can’t think of even one other time before this that lasted that long. I’ve had sad days or stressful periods, but not two weeks straight like you’re asking.
Before this current period, have you ever had at least two separate times in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
No, I don’t have anything different to add there. I don’t remember having two separate stretches like that before this current one.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and then later felt better for at least two months before another period like that happened again?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t remember having that kind of pattern before this—two weeks feeling that way, then a couple months better, and then another period like it.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and then later felt better for at least two months before another period like that happened again?
I don’t think so. I know you’ve asked it a couple ways, but before this, I really don’t recall having that kind of episode and then being better for months and having it happen again.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and then later felt better for at least two months before another period like that happened again?
No, I still don’t recall anything like that before now. I can’t think of a time where it happened, got better for a couple months, and then came back again.
